Keeping SDLC documentation useful with Docs-as-Code

        
Long Word documents buried in shared drives go stale within weeks. Engineering teams keep documentation accurate by storing Markdown templates inside the repository (for example under docs/adr/ and docs/runbooks/), reviewing changes in the same pull requests as code, and keeping each document short enough to read in under five minutes.
